name: product-weekly-sender
description: Downloads one product weekly report from the reports page.

displayDescription.zh: 按用户点名的产品，下载报告页上的产品周报 PDF 或 PNG。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Send me the latest weekly report for a product I name.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 发我下金舆基石一号的产品周报

quickPrompts.en: Send me the latest weekly report for a product I name.
quickPrompts.zh: 发我下金舆基石一号的产品周报

quickPrompts.en: Send the PNG of that product weekly report.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这只产品周报的 PNG 发我
